summary: WP2 docsys-wp-root-readme-reduction is ready for ImplementationDesign. Existing intent architecture already covers the accepted quieter root README adoption entry, stable design reference routing, and documentation layer content boundary; no SystemArchitecture mutation is required. ImplementationDesign should reduce README.md into a concise adoption/product router and must not implement the full contributor guide, the design navigation WP, or invent a root OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md if absent.
notes: Work package scope: docsys-wp-root-readme-reduction / Root README Noise Reduction Work, second step in docsys-wp-information-architecture -> docsys-wp-root-readme-reduction -> docsys-wp-contributor-entrypoint -> docsys-wp-design-navigation -> docsys-wp-link-fact-verification.

Adequacy decision: no graph mutation was required. MCP getIntentElementContext passed for docsys-root-readme-entry, docsys-stable-design-reference, and docsys-content-boundary-requirement; argo.validateSystemArchitecture passed for design/KG/SystemArchitecture.json.

Coverage proof: docsys-root-readme-entry has same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DOC-01 covering first-time root README adoption comprehension; docsys-stable-design-reference has same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DOC-03 covering deep MCP/validator routing without README overload; docsys-content-boundary-requirement has same-element mounted ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DOC-04 covering single-source placement discipline.

Acceptance test evidence: argo.runArchitectureTests reported DOC-01, DOC-02, DOC-03, and DOC-04 passed. The same full run reported two unrelated failures outside WP2 scope: ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-W3-1-MutationEmbeddingVectorE2E and ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-SP-03-DefaultVectorRetrieval.

Explicit acceptance boundaries for WP2: DOC-01 control point is a first-time external reader opening only README.md; observation point is that within five minutes the reader can state ARGO positioning, problem, three core components, and the correct next document. DOC-03 control point is a reader searching from root README for getSystemArchitecture, semantic query, or mutation validation details; observation point is landing on design/mcp and design/validator references without duplicated deep specification in root README. DOC-04 control point is a maintainer placing domain, marketing, research, or stable design content; observation point is correct placement in design/specific-domain, design/marketing, notes, or stable design docs.

ImplementationDesign boundary: README.md should retain positioning, problem framing, certainty formula, three core components, high-level delivery flow, quick start/deployment check, entry selection, and curated next links while routing deep semantic operator, MCP, and lifecycle detail to stable design references.

Do not implement the full contributor guide or design navigation work package in WP2. A minimal link stub is allowed only if needed to keep README routing coherent. Contributor governance should eventually be root-level CONTRIBUTING.md unless later implementation evidence blocks it.
Do not claim or invent root OVERALL_ARCHITECTURE.md if absent; represent the root implementation contract gap honestly as residual coordination for later work.

Human approval: the human pre-authorized approval gates and necessary stage commits for this orchestrated task. The handoff schema has additionalProperties=false and no approvedByHuman field, so global handoff approval is recorded here in notes.
